supersedes: The earlier prohibition on additional training and revised flight checks. Historical finetune_plan.json and run evidence remain immutable.

first_revision.name: inference_revision_01
changes: Use one explicit Gaussian flow-noise tensor from the existing seed 20261024 for every inference. Equal observations no longer get a different random action sample merely because the request sequence changed. No seed selection or model weight change.

Navigation instruction progression requires own estimated speed below the existing 0.08 m/s for the existing 3.25 s, and mean requested velocity over that window below the existing 0.035 m/s. Independent physical target/stop/landing scores are untouched.
first_revision.evaluation: Run blue, red, turns and independent left once each, keep every outcome; no automatic retry.
